newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, LS fuel jumps $5.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, LS fuel jumps $5.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, despite gains of 50 cents a barrel on Brent.
Gasoline slipped 50 cents despite strong demand for June against forward periods but naphtha was steady.
Gas oil gained $2 a tonne on barges as a dollar gain on premiums was matched but a dollar climb on the underlying futures.
Heavy fuel was flat on barges but the low sulphur market was sharply stronger as U.S. demand dragging physical levels up to swaps levels.
